name: Custom Shape 3-Layer Acrylic Bottle Opener Keychain
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic and metal, offering a durable, modern, and functional design.
    - Features a 3-layer acrylic construction combined with a built-in metal bottle opener for added practicality.
    - Layer 1 and Layer 3 are made of acrylic with a 2mm thickness, creating a sturdy and eye-catching outer design.
    - Layer 2 is acrylic with a 2mm thickness and has no printing, serving as the middle support structure.
    - Built-in metal opener has a thickness of 1.8mm, providing strength and reliable everyday use.
    - Comes with a sturdy keyring and chain, making it easy to carry and attach to keys, bags, or accessories.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall product size: 3.5 x 3.5 in ~ 8.89 x 8.89 cm.
    - Keyring length: 5 cm ~ 1.97 in.
    - Metal opener size: 7 x 3.8 cm ~ 2.76 x 1.5 in.
    - Minimum size of custom acrylic piece: 2 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Layer 1 and 3 support 1-sided printing.
    - Layer 2 has no printing, helping reinforce the layered structure.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized keychain and a practical bottle opener.
    - Designed for easy carrying with keys, backpacks, handbags, or travel accessories.
    - Built-in metal opener allows quick and convenient bottle opening anytime.
    - Lightweight yet durable, making it suitable for everyday use.
    - Perfect for personal use, party favors, promotional gifts, souvenirs, and branded merchandise.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for friends, family members, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, Father’s Day, anniversaries, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for sports fans, pet lovers, branding events, bachelor parties, and custom souvenir collections.
    - A creative gift for businesses, clubs, teams, and promotional campaigns.
    - Great for everyday carry, memorable keepsakes, and practical custom accessories.
    - Adds a fun, unique, and useful touch to daily life 🎁 🎁🎁

  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
